links.outcome: Guardrail model classification of harmful prompts and responses in finance, medical, legal domains under adversarial attack
links.effect: ExpGuard surpassed WildGuard by up to 8.9% in prompt classification and 15.3% in response classification, with competitive performance on eight public benchmarks and resilience to domain-specific adversarial attacks.
links.quote: Comprehensive evaluations conducted on ExpGuardTest and eight established public benchmarks reveal that ExpGuard delivers competitive performance across the board while demonstrating exceptional resilience to domain-specific adversarial attacks, surpassing state-of-the-art models such as WildGuard by up to 8.9% in prompt classification and 15.3% in response classification.

unlisted_practices: Training domain-specialized guardrail classifier models for harmful prompt and response moderation in finance, medical, and legal domains

screen.reason: Evaluates and benchmarks a domain-specific guardrail model (ExpGuard) for moderating harmful inputs and outputs in specialized sectors, including the medical domain.

primary.practice: domain-specific input and output guardrails / content moderation
